build_command: g++ -O3 -std=c++11 -DNDEBUG -D__STDC_LIMIT_MACROS -D__STDC_FORMAT_MACROS -I. -Icore -Isimp -Imtl -Iutils core/Solver.cc core/lcm.cc simp/SimpSolver.cc simp/Main.cc utils/Options.cc utils/System.cc -lz -lpsapi -o glucose-simp.exe

configurations.name: Glucose Baseline Restarts + Baseline Reduction
configurations.description: Native Glucose 4.2.1 dynamic restarts based on LBD moving average (K=0.8, R=1.4) and baseline clause reduction.

configurations.name: Adaptive Restart V1 + Baseline Reduction
configurations.description: Adaptive Restart V1 tracking propagation efficiency Sharpe ratio with degradation threshold theta=0.60, min interval=50, warmup=100.

configurations.name: Finance-Inspired V3 Drawdown-Only + Baseline Reduction
configurations.description: Finance-Inspired Restart V3 using sustained relative drawdown trigger (Dt >= 0.75 for 30 consecutive conflicts), trend disabled, ceiling disabled.

configurations.name: No-Heuristic Restarts + Baseline Reduction
configurations.description: Zero heuristic restarts (do_restart = false), executing only Glucose's native strategy adaptation at conflict 100,000.

configurations.name: Glucose Baseline Restarts + Adaptive-Fixed Reduction
configurations.description: Native Glucose restarts paired with multi-attribute adaptive learned clause retention (LBD 0.50, Activity 0.40, Size 0.10) and monotonic reduction scheduling.

configurations.name: Adaptive Restart V1 + Adaptive-Fixed Reduction
configurations.description: Adaptive Restart V1 paired with multi-attribute adaptive-fixed clause retention.

configurations.name: Finance-Inspired V3 Drawdown-Only + Adaptive-Fixed Reduction
configurations.description: V3 Drawdown-Only restart policy paired with multi-attribute adaptive-fixed clause retention.

configurations.name: No-Heuristic Restarts + Adaptive-Fixed Reduction
configurations.description: No heuristic restarts paired with multi-attribute adaptive-fixed clause retention.
